key_insight: Detonation-spray parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium dioxide–based metal-ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide spray settings to improve coating water repellency while controlling thickness and surface texture.
method: Vary nozzle travel speed and spray distance during detonation spraying.
Characterize coating roughness, thickness, and contact angle.
Derive predictive relationships and identify settings for maximum hydrophobicity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle speed and roughness or thickness, and parabolic relationships between spray distance and roughness or contact angle.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical optimal settings, parameter ranges, or prediction errors, limiting direct process transfer.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
